jobs.title: Housekeeping Team Member
jobs.description:
As a Housekeeping Team Member, you will play an important role in creating a clean, comfortable and welcoming environment for our guests. Your work behind the scenes will directly shape how guests feel during their stay, helping them relax, feel cared for and truly at home.

You will be responsible for cleaning and maintaining guest rooms and public areas to agreed standards, ensuring each space is presented with care and attention to detail. By working calmly, efficiently and consistently within set timeframes, you will help maintain the high standards our guests expect and trust.

Key Responsibilities

Clean and service guest bedrooms and public areas to company standards within allocated timeframes
Follow agreed cleaning and presentation standards for all room categories
Report any damages, maintenance issues or breakages promptly to ensure repairs can be carried out
Maintain cleanliness and organisation in linen rooms, cupboards and working areas
Return all cleaning equipment to designated storerooms at the end of each shift
Work safely and responsibly, following hygiene and health & safety guidelines
Contribute positively to the team by working cooperatively and reliably

jobs.title: Business Development Manager
jobs.description:
Be Part of Bristol's First Luxury Five Star Lifestyle Hotel

Hotel Gotham first turned heads in Manchester, earning the title of "Europe's sexiest hotel". Following a show-stopping opening in Newcastle, the curtain now rises on the next act of the Gotham story - and this time, Bristol takes centre stage.

The iconic Grade II listed Guildhall is being thoughtfully transformed into Bristol's first luxury five star lifestyle hotel. Rich in history and architectural grandeur, expect breathtaking Gothic windows, magnificent stained glass and original period features around every corner. It's a setting worthy of Gotham.

Hotel Gotham is more than just a hotel – it’s a way of life. A vibe. A 5-star, theatrical, vibrant, stylish, dramatic experience – for guests and colleagues.

As Business Development Manager, you'll play a pivotal role in building the commercial foundations of Hotel Gotham Bristol ahead of opening and throughout its first chapter. You'll be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, developing strong client relationships and driving revenue across the entire hotel, from bedrooms and events to every F&B outlet.

This role is about more than sales, you'll be the face of Gotham in the Bristol market, building relationships, creating opportunities and ensuring the hotel becomes a destination for business, celebrations, dining and unforgettable experiences. You'll be responsible in assisting build our local presence, keeping our socials current and relevant and ensuring Gotham remains distinctive and iconic.

Your key responsibilities will include:

Develop and deliver a proactive sales strategy across bedrooms, events and all F&B outlets
Identify and secure new business across leisure, group, agency, local and regional markets
Drive group bedroom revenue, increasing room nights, average rate and overall revenue
Promote Gotham's F&B experiences, including our signature restaurant, Judges Chambers, GUILT and rooftop bar, COPPER, maximising private hire, dining and corporate opportunities
Build and nurture strong relationships with local businesses, event agencies, travel partners, and key influencers.
Generate new business through sales calls, networking, client entertaining, show rounds and industry events
Work closely with department heads, Reservations, F&B and Operations to ensure opportunities are successfully converted and delivered
Monitor local competitors, market trends and commercial opportunities, using insight to strengthen Gotham's offering
Collaborate with PR and Bespoke Hotels Central Marketing to maximise opportunities and maintain an engaging, on-trend Gotham presence across social and local marketing
Maintain accurate sales activity, leads, accounts and hotel data, while reporting regularly on performance and opportunities
Represent Hotel Gotham Bristol at industry events and networking opportunities, acting as a true ambassador for the Gotham brand
Support the hotel's business planning, local marketing, merchandising and pursuit of industry recognition

We're looking for passionate hospitality professionals ready to take centre stage and help bring the Gotham experience to life from day one. If you have exceptional communication skills, outstanding attention to detail and thrive as part of a high-performing team, we'd love to hear from you.

Why Join Hotel Gotham Bristol?

Be part of the opening team at Bristol's first luxury five-star lifestyle hotel.
Work in one of the city's most iconic historic buildings.
Join a passionate, supportive and ambitious founding cast.
Opportunities for training, career development and progression.
Staff discounts
Inclusion in service charge additional to salary
